Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614458 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614458. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
